ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Goodhands
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has pulled more patients through than anyone here, through fevers and under the knife. People say they're in good hands with {PAWN_objective}, and now they call {PAWN_objective} Goodhands.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Midwife
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has brought more of the colony's children into the world than anyone. Whatever else {PAWN_pronoun} does, everyone calls {PAWN_objective} the Midwife now.
